summary: The third run of the heartbeat fsync arm came back inside the band the earlier runs set: 71 inversions across 200 attempts with 402 term writes, a mean term write of 3.1 ms and a maximum of 14.4 ms, against 89 and 69 inversions at means near 2.0 and 2.5 ms. That matters because this is the run with the slowest writes of the three, so the inversion is not confined to the faster storage conditions and the account's conclusion holds without needing a new number. I rewrote the fsync limitation to report all three runs and to keep the caveat that no run varies the storage stack, file system or sync mode, so what reproduces is the exposure on this platform rather than a field rate, and appended the parsed events for the case and its result to the rationale along with the repeat note in the joint history. The five counterevidence items, the other five limitations, both knowledge uses at revisions 7 and 9 and the empty answers are carried forward unchanged, and the conclusion stays violated with the scoped defect asserted.
